method.strength_basis: Approximate mean cylinder concrete strength; steel and fiber properties as stated, not individual measured coupon strengths.
method.wrap_clause: Not applicable: only longitudinal soffit sheets reported; no wrap or U-wrap capacity assumed.

ACI_reference.scope: Official preview verifies guide identity, flexural strengthening chapter and anchorage qualifications; full equation/clause text is not in the preview. Formula is supplied by job and frozen val_frp.py.
ACI_reference.clause_verification: Full flexural equation clause number not independently verified; do not claim full guide compliance.

method.IS456_bare: Indian Standard 456:2000, clause 38.1: plane sections, no concrete tension, 0.0035 crushing; parabola-rectangle scaled to 0.67 times strength, material safety factors removed, steel elastoplastic. Mean cylinder used directly as strength proxy because mean cube strength is missing; conditional benchmark, not a code design resistance.

assumed_self_weight.Ec_basis: 5000*sqrt(20) as a declared nominal modulus proxy, not measured; cylinder strength not IS cube strength.
assumed_self_weight.initial_strain_basis: Gross uncracked elastic section, neutral axis at middepth; beam simply supported under self-weight at bonding.

GFRP_PostStr.source: p. 10, Figure 7, first bare unloading branch
GFRP_PostStr.assumptions: Residual shape assigned the elastic four-point shape and bare-yield neutral axis; actual plastic curvature distribution and residual stresses unknown.

limitations: Cured composite coupon data and longitudinal fiber orientation missing; no unconditional capacity validation.
Top compression-steel depth inferred; no tuning of strengths or geometry.
Post-strengthened yield is not separately reported; comparison unavailable.
Residual displacement cannot uniquely determine local substrate strain.
A scalar initial-strain offset cannot represent plastic steel strain, crack localization, bond degradation or concrete crushing.
No strength reduction/safety factors; output is not a design recommendation.
